title: Thompson Sampling for Learning in Zero-Sum Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.18899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thompson sampling (TS) achieves logarithmic and asymptotically optimal regret in classical stochastic bandits, but its behavior in multi-agent learning remains less understood. We study TS in an unknown finite two-player zero-sum matrix game with Gaussian bandit feedback. Under centralized self-play, TS samples a single payoff matrix from the posterior and plays a Nash equilibrium of the sampled game. For every fixed zero-sum game with a unique Nash equilibrium, we show that the expected cumulative duality gap is $O(\sqrt T)$. The rate improves to $O(\log T)$ for pure equilibria. We then identify the exact coefficient of the $\sqrt T$ term, which depends only on the equilibrium strategies and the noise level. We also establish a minimax lower bound matching the square-root dependence on $T$ and an instance-dependent lower bound matching the logarithmic dependence on $T$ for a class of games with a unique pure equilibrium. translated_title: 零和博弈中学习的汤普森采样
translated_abstract: 汤普森采样（TS）在经典随机老虎机中实现了对数级和渐近最优的遗憾值，但其在多智能体学习中的行为仍鲜为人知。我们研究了汤普森采样在具有高斯老虎机反馈的未知有限双人零和矩阵博弈中的表现。在集中式自博弈下，TS从后验中采样单个收益矩阵，并执行采样博弈的一个纳什均衡。对于每一个具有唯一纳什均衡的固定零和博弈，我们证明了期望累积对偶间隙为 $O(\sqrt T)$。对于纯均衡情形，该速率可提升至 $O(\log T)$。随后我们确定了 $\sqrt T$ 项的精确系数，该系数仅取决于均衡策略和噪声水平。我们还建立了与 $T$ 的平方根依赖关系相匹配的极小极大下界，以及对于一类具有唯一纯均衡的博弈，与 $T$ 的对数依赖关系相匹配的实例相关下界。实验表明……
tldr: 本文首次证明了在具有唯一纳什均衡的未知双人零和矩阵博弈中，汤普森采样可实现 $O(\sqrt T)$ 的对偶间隙遗憾（纯均衡情形下为 $O(\log T)$），并给出了与之匹配的极小极大下界和实例相关下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Thompson sampling achieves $O(\sqrt T)$ expected duality gap regret ($O(\log T)$ for pure equilibria) in unknown two-player zero-sum matrix games with unique Nash equilibria, establishing matching minimax and instance-dependent lower bounds.
